item.title: Regular and orderly
item.description: Why the most boring parts of my week are the reason the interesting work happens, and what that has to do with architecture.

item.title: Standards that stick
item.description: Most engineering standards die in a wiki. The ones that stick are code people want to use. Here's what made the difference for me.

item.title: When AI writes the code, architecture matters more
item.description: AI made writing code cheap. It didn't make deciding what to build cheap, which is why architecture matters more now, not less.
